people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Sinai
people.line: Mountain where Moses received the Ten Commandments

translations.web: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
translations.bsb: These are the words of the covenant that the LORD commanded Moses to make with the Israelites in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant He had made with them at Horeb.
translations.kjv: These are the words of the covenant, which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, beside the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
translations.asv: These are the words of the covenant which Jehovah commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, besides the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
